paragraphs: A participant may stop taking part at any time. Information collected before withdrawal may remain in the study records and may be included in the analysis as permitted by the consent and applicable requirements.

Participants may stop at any time without penalty or loss of usual benefits by telling or writing to the site coordinator. A final discussion of symptoms and ordinary care is optional; no final research test, diary submission or additional data collection is mandatory after withdrawal. The investigator may discontinue participation at the participant’s request, if assessments cannot be completed, or if the study closes. Record the reason when available. Eligible expenses already incurred remain reimbursable; do not require diary completion or study completion as a condition of reimbursement.

blocks.text: The investigator may discontinue participation for participant request, inability to complete assessments, additional ocular surgery or study closure. The reason is recorded when available. Discontinuation is distinct from completion, and leaving research does not stop routine care. A final discussion of symptoms and ordinary-care needs is offered but optional; no mandatory final research visit, saliva collection or examination is required after withdrawal.
